units: <cite ref="Megillah 13b:15">Meg. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ שמחה גדולה</he> he rejoiced exceedingly.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 18b:16">M. Kat. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ראה … וש׳</he> he saw others do wrong and rejoiced over it; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 10b:2">B. Bath. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>יְשַׂמֵּחַ את אשתו בדבר מצוה</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) let him make his wife cheerful by means of a good deed.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 6b:16">R. Hash. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>אשה בעלה מְשַׂמְּחָהּ</he> as to a woman’s festive joy, her husband must rejoice her (with dresses &c.); <cite ref="Kiddushin 34b">Kidd. 34ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 109a:3">Pes. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>חייב אדם לְשַׂמֵּחַ וכ׳</he> man is bound to gladden his children and the members of his household on the festival; <he>במה מְשַׂמְּחָם</he> wherewith should he gladden them? <cite ref="Ketubot 8a:4">Keth. 8ᵃ</cite> (in marriage benedictions) <he>מְשַׂמֵּחַ ציון בבניה</he> who gladdens Zion through (restoring to her) her children; <he>משמח חתן וכלה</he> who gladdens bridegroom and bride; <he>מש׳ חתן עם הכלה</he> who gladdens the bridegroom with the bride; <he>שַׂמֵּח תְּשַׂמַּח … כשַׂמֵּחֲךָ וכ׳</he> mayest thou gladden the beloved friends, as thou didst gladden thy creature (Adam) &c.; a. fr.
